checks.name: Redocly structural lint (openapi/openapi.yaml, --extends=spec)
checks.detail: Command: `mise exec -- npx --yes @redocly/cli@latest lint openapi/openapi.yaml --extends=spec`. Output: "openapi/openapi.yaml: validated in 11ms / Woohoo! Your API description is valid." Diff vs HEAD confirmed additive-only: `enum: [add, sub, mul, div, mod]` -> `enum: [add, sub, mul, div, mod, pow, avg]` (no removals/narrowing).

checks.name: Full contract/HTTP test suite (npm test / vitest run)
checks.detail: Command: `mise exec -- npm test` (vitest v3.2.7). Result: 3 test files, 21 tests, all passed in 335ms. Files: tests/contracts/memory.test.ts (6 passed), tests/contracts/calculator.test.ts (11 passed, incl. new `describe("OCL Calculator::avg")` block asserting result = (a+b)/2 for (2,4)->3, (-2,3)->0.5, (0,0)->0, and explicitly asserting `PreconditionError` is never thrown for avg on b<=0 / a==0 inputs that would reject div/mod), tests/http/server.test.ts (4 passed, incl. `dispatches op:avg through the OPERATIONS whitelist and returns 200 {result}` sending a real `POST /calculate` with op:"avg" over an actual server instance/fetch and asserting {result:6} for a=2,b=10). No test file, describe block, or assertion for add/sub/mul/div/mod/pow/memory was modified or removed — all pre-existing tests pass unmodified, confirming no regression.

checks.name: TypeScript typecheck (tsc --noEmit)
checks.detail: Command: `mise exec -- node node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p .`. Exit code 0, no diagnostics. Confirms `Calculator.avg` and the `OPERATIONS` whitelist extension type-check against the existing `Operation` union with no `any`/unsafe casts introduced.
